system.description:
You use your mechanical strength to restrain and damage enemies.

Prerequisites: Droid, Claw or Hand Appendage, Base Attack Bonus +1, Pin, Crush

Effect: When you successfully Pin an enemy, you can maintain the Pin beyond 1 round and can make subsequent Grapple checks against the Pinned enemy as a Swift Action. You can apply the Crush Feat whenever your subsequent checks are successful.

Normal: Grapple checks are a Standard Action. The Pin Feat must be rerolled each round as a new Grapple check.

Special: You must have a Claw or Hand Appendage to use this Feat.

prerequisite.text: Droid, (Claw or Hand), Base Attack Bonus 1, Pin feat, and Crush feat
